title: Scriptorium: System Design and Implementation of a Multi-Human, Multi-AI Collaborative Digital Library Search Platform
abstract: arXiv:2610.28929v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This technical report documents the design and implementation of Scriptorium, a digital library search interface designed to support multi-human, multi-AI collaboration: full cross-user transparency of search activity combined with a Manager--Worker architecture of seven role-specialized generative AI agents. A companion short demonstration paper describes Scriptorium's interaction design; because a demonstration format is constrained to a few pages, it necessarily omits most implementation detail. This report documents Scriptorium's complete system architecture, data model, collaborative-interaction design rationale, and AI orchestration mechanism, including verbatim agent prompts, the deterministic guardrails that constrain them, the language model and retrieval configuration, and the steps needed to run the system, so that the design can be inspected, critiqued, reproduced, and reused by other researchers. We also discuss the system

translated_title: Scriptorium：多人类、多AI协作的数字图书馆搜索平台的系统设计与实现
translated_abstract: 本技术报告记录了Scriptorium的设计与实现，这是一个旨在支持多人类、多AI协作的数字图书馆搜索界面：实现了搜索活动的完全跨用户透明性，并结合了由七个角色专门化的生成式AI智能体组成的“管理者-工作者”（Manager-Worker）架构。一篇配套的简短演示论文描述了Scriptorium的交互设计；由于演示格式受限于几页篇幅，必然省略了大部分实现细节。本报告记录了Scriptorium的完整系统架构、数据模型、协作交互设计原理以及AI编排机制，包括智能体提示词原文、约束这些提示词的确定性防护机制、语言模型与检索配置，以及运行系统所需的步骤，以便其他研究人员能够检查、批评、复现和重用该设计。我们还讨论了该系统（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了Scriptorium，一个支持多人类与多AI协作的数字图书馆搜索平台，其核心创新在于将完全跨用户透明的搜索活动与由七个角色专门化生成式AI智能体组成的管理者-工作者架构相结合，并完整公开系统实现细节以支持复现与重用。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Scriptorium, a digital library search platform for multi-human, multi-AI collaboration, whose key innovation is combining full cross-user transparency of search activity with a Manager-Worker architecture of seven role-specialized generative AI agents, while openly documenting the complete system implementation for reproducibility and reuse.
